date_basis: Archive date; original report filename supplies MMDD=0917, not a full measurement timestamp.
translation_note: Comments and docstrings are translated into English. Node filenames and search-state hashes remain original source identifiers; report_sha256 describes the translated file, and original_report_sha256 links to the original evaluation cache.
path_base: Paths in this file are relative to the operator directory.
provenance_note: This record describes the search data at report import time. Live nodes, optimization.md, and searchstate.json are replaced on subsequent updates; use Git history if the original node or evaluation entry is no longer present.
